+++ b/src/click/numeric_type_error.py
@@ -0,0 +1,28 @@
+from __future__ import annotations
+
+import typing as t
+from gettext import gettext as _
+
+from .types import _NumberParamTypeBase
+
+if t.TYPE_CHECKING:
+    from .core import Context
+    from .core import Parameter
+
+
+class NumericTypeError(_NumberParamTypeBase):
+    """Report invalid numeric input as a bad parameter for either error type."""
+
+    def convert(
+        self, value: t.Any, param: Parameter | None, ctx: Context | None
+    ) -> t.Any:
+        try:
+            return self._number_class(value)
+        except (TypeError, ValueError):
+            self.fail(
+                _("{value!r} is not a valid {number_type}.").format(
+                    value=value, number_type=self.name
+                ),
+                param,
+                ctx,
+            )
notes:
Added NumericTypeError in a standalone module. Its override preserves the base signature and localized failure path, and handles TypeError alongside ValueError without editing existing modules.
